content.text: Close match to the target now. Exporting.

I built the clevis and exported it to `submission.step`. The export was read back as one valid solid that matches the part. My last preview from the same four cameras matches `composite.png` closely. The IoU score itself only comes when you finish, so I don't know it yet.

**What the part is:**
- **Block:** a rectangular block 48 (X) × 40 (Y) × 84 (Z), standing upright.
- **Slot:** 16 wide in X and centred, cut 48 deep from the top and running all the way through in Y. This leaves two upright arms.
- **Pin hole:** Ø12 at Z = 67, going through both arms along X.

All the sizes are my estimates from the pictures. Size doesn't affect the score, only proportions, so I tuned them over three renders. The top of the slot and the arm thickness were the hardest to read in the composite, so those are the most likely to be slightly off.

Files are in the workspace: `part.FCStd` (the part), `preview.png` (last render) and `submission.step` (what gets scored). You can view the model at http://127.0.0.1:8771/#part.FCStd.
